<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="11%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>Item&#8201;5.02</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Departure of Directors or Principal Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Principal Officers.
</B></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Effective as of the open of business on October&nbsp;9, 2026, Joseph M. Cohen was appointed as a director of MSGS
Spinco, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) by the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;). In addition, the Board appointed Mr.&nbsp;Cohen as a member of the Audit Committee and the Compensation Committee of the Board effective as
of the time of Mr.&nbsp;Cohen&#8217;s appointment to the Board. Mr.&nbsp;Cohen&#8217;s biographical and compensation information is included in the Information Statement filed as Exhibit 99.1 to Amendment No.&nbsp;4 of the Company&#8217;s
registration statement on Form 10 (the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;) filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on September&nbsp;30, 2026 in connection with the distribution by Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (&#8220;MSG
Sports&#8221;) to its stockholders of all of the issued and outstanding shares of Company&#8217;s common stock as set forth in the Registration Statement (the &#8220;Distribution&#8221;). Such information is incorporated into this Item 5.02 by
reference. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="11%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>Item&#8201;8.01</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Other Events. </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s Registration Statement became effective on October&nbsp;9, 2026 at 4:00 p.m., New York City time. The Information Statement
dated October&nbsp;9, 2026, which is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1, is substantially in the form attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Registration Statement. The Distribution is expected to occur at 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on October&nbsp;26,
2026. Prior to the Distribution, the Information Statement will be mailed to MSG Sports&nbsp;stockholders as of the close of business on October&nbsp;20, 2026, the record date for the Distribution. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The foregoing description is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Information Statement. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
